blocks.raw: <WikiMistakeList mistakes={[ "Assuming Dao or Tangile resists termites because they resist decay. Decay and termite resistance are separate mechanisms.", "Accepting sapwood freely because the piece has 'mostly heartwood.' The 5% rule is absolute; 6% sapwood fails ground-contact use.", "Treating Yakal or Apitong as naturally durable alternatives to Narra. They have no documented resistance; treatment is mandatory for resistance claims.", "Confusing heartwood color with heartwood identity. Heartwood must be chemically extractive-rich, not just visually distinct." ]} />
